summary: Frontend E2E for SpaceForge Session 2 completed. Firebase signup on /auth (Sign Up tab) succeeded end-to-end: dev-bridge exchanged for JWT via POST /api/v1/auth/exchange/ (200) and app redirected to /data-agent. All 8 enterprise apps load without auth errors and hit real Django /api/v1/* endpoints with 200s. Operations app auto-loads GET /api/v1/applications/operations/ (200) and renders the Operational Intelligence dashboard (not 'Unable to load'). Executive app renders dataset picker + Prepare & Analyze / Load Bundle buttons in empty state (no crash). /data-agent renders upload workspace and tenant bootstrap calls succeed (/organizations/, /workspaces/ 200 during initial signup redirect). No 401/403 auth errors observed on any /api/v1 traffic.

minor.issue: Frontend fires duplicate 201 creates for the same tenant on first login (2x organizations, 2x workspaces). Backend accepts but this looks like a client race condition in tenant bootstrap in platform/index.ts. Not user-facing but wastes resources.
One 429 (Too Many Requests) response on a non-/api/v1 resource observed during navigation churn; not blocking auth/app loads.

ui_bugs.issue: Could not find an enterprise global search input at the top of the /apps layout. The sidebar shows a 'Search platform...' input but typing did not trigger GET /api/v1/enterprise-services/search/. This spec item (global search fires enterprise-services/search) could not be validated as PASS.

Page renders (no crash, no 'Unable to load') but issued 0 /api/v1 network calls on load. Every other app fires at least an org/workspace/dataset call. Verify Sankey is intentionally lazy (waits for a dataset selection) — otherwise it may be missing its backend integration.

A 'What best describes you?' persona modal appears on first /data-agent visit and is NOT dismissed by localStorage['onboarding-completed']='true'. This can block automated flows and re-visits. Consider gating on the same flag or an additional 'persona-selected' flag.

integration_issues.issue: Console error: 'Failed to fetch credits: [SpaceForge] backend is not connected. Enterprise backend pending.' — a stub adapter is still being used for credits even though VITE_API_BASE_URL is set. Check platform/index.ts routing for the credits service.

action_items: Verify enterprise global search UI: expose a top-of-/apps search input (or trigger) that calls GET /api/v1/enterprise-services/search/. Current sidebar 'Search platform...' does not fire that endpoint.

Fix duplicate tenant bootstrap: on first signup the app POSTs /organizations/ and /workspaces/ twice (likely double effect / React 18 StrictMode + missing dedup in platform/index.ts tenant bootstrap).
Route credits service to Django adapter (still hitting stub: 'backend is not connected').
Confirm Sankey app is intended to be lazy — if not, wire it to /api/v1 like the other apps.
Persona picker modal on /data-agent is not covered by 'onboarding-completed' bypass; either extend that flag or add a separate localStorage key so automated smoke tests can proceed.
critical_code_review_comments: platform/index.ts tenant bootstrap appears non-idempotent (double org+workspace creation on first login).
Credits fetch path bypasses VITE_API_BASE_URL routing — still using stub adapter.
Enterprise pages lack data-testid attributes as noted — recommend adding them at least to top-level page containers, primary action buttons, and the global search input for reliable automation.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (7/8 apps fully verified + auth+data-agent; global search unverified, sankey lazy)

test_credentials: Firebase signup created fresh each run. This run used qa+1786036468@spaceforge.test / Passw0rd!23 (display name 'QA Tester'). Redirect to /data-agent confirmed.
seed_data_creation: None (no datasets uploaded — empty-state paths validated as spec allows).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth signup path is solid: Sign Up tab -> Display Name/Email/Password -> Create Account. Password >=6 chars. Set localStorage['onboarding-completed']='true' via add_init_script before nav to bypass the /auth-blocking overlay (but note a SECOND persona modal appears on /data-agent). All 8 /apps/* routes are reachable post-auth and issue real /api/v1 calls. Duplicate org/workspace POSTs on first login are expected currently. Global enterprise search endpoint could not be triggered from the UI — the sidebar 'Search platform...' input did not fire /api/v1/enterprise-services/search/.
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking issues. Non-blocking notes: (1) Duplicate tenant bootstrap likely from double-invocation of a useEffect (React 18 StrictMode dev / dependency array) in platform/index.ts. (2) 'backend is not connected' credits error indicates a stub adapter is still wired for credits despite VITE_API_BASE_URL routing being enabled elsewhere. (3) Global search endpoint absent from UI trigger surface.
